description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelRelFieldEditButton, which extends SugarWidgetField, responsible for rendering an edit button in a subpanel relation context within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. The class includes methods to display header cells and list items, with the list method currently printing layout definitions and containing JavaScript for editing relationships.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelRelFieldEditButton
classes.description: Widget class for rendering an edit button in subpanel relationship fields within SugarCRM and SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space for the header cell; does not display any content.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Currently prints the layout definition for debugging purposes; contains JavaScript for opening an inline relationship editor, and builds an HTML snippet with an edit icon that triggers the editor.
